reviews.text: It is impossible to update guests efficiently with this update.

reviews.title: Messages needs to be easier to find
reviews.text: It’s nearly impossible to find messages from event organizers in this app.

reviews.title: Got hacked
reviews.text: I am so angry! A  nonprofit I volunteer for got hacked and all of the readers that opened the link also got hacked as well! I am so angry with this as it sent invites to my sister that I did not send!

reviews.title: Won’t save Won’t send
reviews.text: Time wasted! Created Invitation several times , app wouldn’t save and wouldn’t send invites.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE NON WORKING
reviews.text: I had people RSVP and check in with me and then the app stopped working

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: I’m not sure what’s going on with this app, but when I click on anything, I get an error message. I’d be willing to try premium if the free worked even a little bit, but I don’t dare to pay any money because the error issue keeps getting worse. Initially, I created an invite, but I got an error when I tried to save it, but now I can’t even open a design page. I just get an error when I click on anything.

reviews.title: Registry Option
reviews.text: They added the automatic gift ideas link under every rsvp text and you have to pay to turn it off. Such turn off from the app. So disappointing.

reviews.title: Delete
reviews.text: I made  account and then I deleted the account since I didn’t need anymore invites. So it gave me the option to delete it. It wouldn’t delete the app for me. I tried everything it still has my info. It’s so dumb

reviews.title: New update sucks
reviews.text: The new editing update sucks… I’m switching to something else.

reviews.title: Lack of free options
reviews.text: I’ve used evite for years but lately there are fewer free options!  This was the whole reason I started using them!  I wanted to save on postage which is irrelevant now. It’s too bad that making money takes priority over providing a great service. What is the point in posting ads when you’re just going to charge us for the card anyway?  Also, the whole requiring a nickname to post a review is ridiculous!  They are always taken so people give up and don’t post anything. Super shady!

reviews.title: PAYWALL NOT FREE
reviews.text: It costs money to just upload a photo of your choice and put text over it

reviews.title: Don’t recommend
reviews.text: The free version is ridiculously difficult to use. Features change regularly and your guests will be spammed ad nauseam.

reviews.title: No way to view messages
reviews.text: People have been replying to my evite and there’s no way to view their messages. Bummer since it resulted in people missing the event. You’d think this would be a prominent feature 🙄

reviews.title: Updated the app, now it won’t work
reviews.text: I updated the app so I could make some birthday invitations. The update is glitching and throwing out the Not Authorized error code 10178. I usually enjoy the app, but this is not ok.

reviews.title: Sometimesy
reviews.text: If the app works, it’s great, but I can’t remember the last time it worked well. Things I see: You can’t see messages unless you’ve RSVP’ed (except that it’s says I RSVP’ed Yes). When someone sends you a link the app opens to the general page, not the invitation itself. So you have to keep closing the app and trying again. Honestly, not reliable enough for me to use it or want to use it. Sucks. Used to be good.

reviews.title: Ruined my birthday
reviews.text: Apparently, when sending a message or update/change to your event, it is sent via email instead of via texted! I originally sent the Evite via text to everyone. That’s the only information I had on my guests! The only thing I changed was the date. It was the same place same time. Instead of having a guest of 15 I ended up with four! Completely ruined my birthday dinner! I will never use Evite again!

reviews.title: Don’t use for any formal occasions
reviews.text: Lacks customization needed for a wedding or any formal event.  Things you’d expect to work like customizing a text message don’t exist.  If you pay your recipients still get hit with ads.  Very very disappointed.

reviews.title: Seeking refund
reviews.text: i did their lowest tier for 30 invites. The texts sent out have no identifying information on it so my guests have  been afraid to open it thinking it is fraudulent or a scam. I am now having to reach out to everyone on our guest list on my own to let them know about the party and that the link is safe. Tried to contact customer support and got nowhere. Very disappointed as I was recommended this app by a family member who’s evites were sent out just fine.

reviews.title: Hot garbage
reviews.text:
I’m sorry, but somehow evite has gotten WORSE over the years. How you take a platform that has worked well for decades and make it this bad (all while charging for services that used to be free) is beyond me. It’s AWFUL. 

I will never use this platform again, and will find somewhere else to host event info. 

Absolutely awful.

reviews.title: Zero stars, not one!
reviews.text: The app does not notify me by email, text or otherwise when I get an invitation. The only way I find out I got an invitation is when the inviter contacts me directly to ask me why I didn't reply. There is apparently no way to fix this and when I write for help there is no response.

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: You can create an Evite for hundreds of people but have a link created by Evite completely ruin the RSVPs for your event. Evite will show a handful of responses (often wrong at that). They do not try to fix it. Never again.

reviews.text:
Ads
Uncutomizable
No free animations
Non Pro is useless!

reviews.title: Rip Off
reviews.text: $100 for 88 invitations for one event.

reviews.title: Everyone thinks it is spam!  And event keeps getting canceled!!!
reviews.text:
I figured out that if you make one simple, edit such as the address not being correct or adding additional notes the event gets automatically canceled!!!

Worst part… they do not give a sample name event on the txt. Just … click here and trust me.  Lost 20 invites because they thought it was a phishing scheme. 

 The interface is buggy as hell and is not worth the hundred dollars. I paid for inviting 80 guests. I have to check every five minutes that the stupid thing is not canceling. I’ll never use this garbage software again. Never ever again. You guys suck!

reviews.title: Do Not Recommend
reviews.text: Lots of issues and no help menu on the app. Had to manually enter all my contacts. Several friends also dislike this App but admit they continue to use it because typing in all your contacts one by one is such a pain they continue to deal with all the issues in this App. Not intuitive. I discovered features after I sent my invite because people who used it before told me. Wouldn’t have found them otherwise through use of the App. Even though I was the host and even though I RSVP’d it wouldn’t let me send a message or reminder because I “need to RSVP to send a message”. This is a common problem I discovered by googling for help as there is no help menu. Search results recommended I sign out and back in to fix that issue. Once I signed out, I was never able to sign back in and still can’t. Same error message without any help on how to resolve. I would only recommend this App if you think it would be fun to get locked out the week of your event. Thankfully, the party of 45 people was successful despite this app.

reviews.title: Receiving issues
reviews.text: The app makes cute invites, but I’ve had multiple people tell me they never received the text for the invite so I’ve had to go through my list and see if people had actually received it. The ones that didn’t RSVP or say viewed are the ones that I at knew to at least contact to send the information to.

reviews.title: Buggy Editing Interface
reviews.text: I downloaded the app to quickly edit an invitation draft. The app freezes as soon as you attempt to save any edits and locks you on a text-box input screen. Stay on the web for anything beyond an RSVP

reviews.title: Dysfunctional mobile app
reviews.text: This app takes forever to load and fails at the one thing it is supposed to do, except an RSVP. Multiple bugs and terrible performance.

reviews.title: Maybe its over my head
reviews.text: I tried this out for the first time for a family’s Holliday party. I used premium and sent to about 31 guests at $37. Three guest invite were not delivered because the number was incorrect. The App did not allow me to change the wrong number to the right number and resend. I also forget a family member and when I added an additional guest I was told it would be an additional $18. This is not a fair way to conduct business. There are no instructions of pricing that i could find that would warn me about the additional costs for invites and updates. User beware of hidden costs. I will not us this again.

reviews.title: So frustrating!
reviews.text: Sending the invites is fine but the messages part is just awful.  I finally just started emailing people outside the app.

reviews.title: So glitchy. Went completely downhill
reviews.text: This used to be THE digital invitation. Now it seems archaic. The editing tools leave not many options, you used to be able to upload your own image free, now you have to pay for it.  But the glitchiness is the worst of all. It keeps freezing and not letting you go to the next screen, and it doesn’t even save your drafts anymore, so you have to close the app and then start all over.
